_meta.note: The soil-moisture advisory's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `soilwater.`.

strings.soilwater.no_probe: {bed} has no moisture probe installed within its {depth} cm root zone, so there is no advice for it. Install one, or record where it went.
strings.soilwater.unseen: No reading from {bed}'s probes for {hours:.1f} hours, so there is no advice for it today. Check the probes and their radio.
strings.soilwater.never_seen: No reading has ever arrived from {bed}'s probes. Check them and their radio.
strings.soilwater.untrusted: {bed}'s probe readings failed the health checks ({flags}), so there is no advice for it today. Check the probes before trusting any.
strings.soilwater.too_wet: {bed} is wetter than field capacity, so water is draining past the roots. Don't water it today.
strings.soilwater.rain_coming: {bed} is due for water, with {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use gone, but {rain:.0f} mm of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours. Wait, and check again tomorrow.
strings.soilwater.water_now: Water {bed} today: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone. About {mm:.0f} mm brings it back to field capacity.
strings.soilwater.water_now_ahead: Water {bed} today: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone, and drying at {drying:.1f} mm a day it would be short of water before tomorrow morning. About {mm:.0f} mm brings it back to field capacity.
strings.soilwater.water_soon: {bed} has enough water today. At the rate it is drying it will need water in about {days:.1f} days.
strings.soilwater.enough: {bed} has enough water: {left:.0f}% of what its plants can use is still there.
strings.soilwater.regimen.no_response: {bed}'s probes show almost no new water since this morning: the root zone rose {rise_percent:.1f} points, where {mm:.0f} mm of watering should add about {expected_percent:.1f}. If it was watered, check the drip line and its emitters; if it was not, it still needs water.
strings.soilwater.regimen.no_water_arrived: {bed}'s valve ran {valve_open_min:.0f} minutes this morning, but its probes show almost no new water: the root zone rose {rise_percent:.1f} points, where {mm:.0f} mm should add about {expected_percent:.1f}. Check the drip line and its emitters for a blockage, and the line for a leak.
strings.soilwater.regimen.not_watered: {bed} was due {mm:.0f} mm of water this morning, and its valve did not open. It still needs water.
strings.soilwater.layered: {bed}'s soil is layered: its probe at {shallow} cm drains back to {shallow_fc:.0f}% water after a soaking, the one at {deep} cm to {deep_fc:.0f}%. One soil's values cannot describe it, and the advice may wait too long for the layer whose water the roots cannot take. Give the bed each layer's field capacity and wilting point, from a soil test of each layer or the soil survey's horizons.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now: Water {bed} today, by the farm's weather: about {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone, with no probe to confirm it. About {mm:.0f} mm brings it back to field capacity.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now_corrected: Water {bed} today, by the farm's weather, with its water use set at {et:.0f}% of the weather's estimate from a probe in a bed nearby: about {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone. About {mm:.0f} mm brings it back to field capacity. No probe in {bed} confirms it.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now_unrecorded: {bed} is due water by the farm's weather, about {mm:.0f} mm, with no probe to confirm it. Its watering is not recorded, so this takes the last advice to water as followed; if it was not, it needs more.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now_unrecorded_c: {bed} is due water by the farm's weather, with its water use set at {et:.0f}% of the weather's estimate from a probe in a bed nearby: about {mm:.0f} mm. Its watering is not recorded, so this takes the last advice to water as followed; if it was not, it needs more.
strings.soilwater.weather_rain_coming: {bed} is due water by the farm's weather, with {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use gone, but {rain:.0f} mm of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours. Wait, and check again tomorrow.
strings.soilwater.weather_rain_coming_corrected: {bed} is due water by the farm's weather and a probe in a bed nearby: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone. But {rain:.0f} mm of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours. Wait, and check again tomorrow.
strings.soilwater.weather_enough: {bed} has enough water by the farm's weather: about {left:.0f}% of what its plants can use is left. No probe confirms it.
strings.soilwater.weather_enough_corrected: {bed} has enough water by the farm's weather, with its water use set at {et:.0f}% of the weather's estimate from a probe in a bed nearby: about {left:.0f}% of what its plants can use is left. No probe in {bed} confirms it.
strings.soilwater.weather_unseen: The farm's station missed a full day of weather on {days} of the last three days, so there is no estimate for {bed}, which has no probe. Check the station.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now_anchored: {bed}'s probes have given no reading to trust for {hours:.0f} hours. By the farm's weather since their last good one, about {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone: water it today, about {mm:.0f} mm. And check the probes.
strings.soilwater.weather_rain_coming_anchored: {bed}'s probes have given no reading to trust for {hours:.0f} hours. By the farm's weather since their last good one it is due water, but {rain:.0f} mm of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours: wait. And check the probes.
strings.soilwater.weather_enough_anchored: {bed}'s probes have given no reading to trust for {hours:.0f} hours. By the farm's weather since their last good one, it has enough: about {left:.0f}% of what its plants can use is left. Check the probes.
strings.soilwater.weather_unseen_anchored: {bed}'s probes have given no reading to trust for {hours:.0f} hours, and the farm's station missed a full day on {days} of the last three, so there is no advice for {bed}. Check the probes and the station.
strings.soilwater.soak.pour: Soak test for {bed}: pour {litres:.0f} litres of water over a square metre centred on its probes, a can at a time, letting each soak in before the next. The probes are checked in {hours:.0f} hours, and the result comes two days later.
strings.soilwater.soak.no_rise: After the soak, {bed}'s probes rose only {rise_percent:.1f} points where about {expected_percent:.0f} were expected: a probe may have lost contact with the soil, or the water ran off the square.
strings.soilwater.soak.too_high: After the soak, {bed}'s probes read {peak_percent:.0f}% water, more than a mineral soil can hold (about {saturation_percent:.0f}%): they read high, and need calibrating in this soil.
strings.soilwater.soak.drained: Soak test for {bed}: its root zone drained back to {capacity_percent:.1f}% water. That is its field capacity, measured.
strings.soilwater.soak.not_drained: Soak test for {bed}: two days on, its probes show no drain-down to read field capacity from. The soak may not have wetted the soil past field capacity, or the probes are not reading it.
strings.soilwater.water_now.us: Water {bed} today: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone. About {mm:.1f} inches brings it back to field capacity.
strings.soilwater.water_now_ahead.us: Water {bed} today: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone, and drying at {drying:.2f} inches a day it would be short of water before tomorrow morning. About {mm:.1f} inches brings it back to field capacity.
strings.soilwater.rain_coming.us: {bed} is due for water, with {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use gone, but {rain:.1f} inches of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours. Wait, and check again tomorrow.

strings.soilwater.weather_rain_coming_anchored.u: {bed}'s probes have given no reading to trust for {hours:.0f} hours. By the farm's weather since their last good one it is due water, but {rain:.1f} inches of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours: wait. And check the probes.

About {mm:.1f} inches brings it back to field capacity. No probe in {bed} confirms it.
strings.soilwater.weather_water_now_unrecorded_c: {bed} is due water by the farm's weather, with its water use set at {et:.0f}% of the weather's estimate from a probe in a bed nearby: about {mm:.1f} inches. Its watering is not recorded, so this takes the last advice to water as followed; if it was not, it needs more.
{bed} is due water by the farm's weather and a probe in a bed nearby: {used:.0f}% of the water its plants can use is gone. But {rain:.1f} inches of rain is forecast in the next 24 hours. Wait, and check again tomorrow.
strings.soilwater.roots_blocked: {bed}'s crop should have roots to about {expected:.0f} cm by now, but its probe at {blocked:.0f} cm has stayed level through its dry days while the one at {seen:.0f} cm has dried: something may be stopping the roots, a hardpan or compacted soil. The advice now counts its roots to {used:.0f} cm. If you know how deep the soil lets roots go, set the bed's rooting limit.
